name: Bank of Xi'an Co.,Ltd.
summary: Bank of Xi'an Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides banking products and services in China. It operates through Corporate Banking, Personal Banking Business, Capital Operations, and Other segments. The Corporate Finance segment provides corporate deposit, loans and advances, trade financing, bond underwriting services, agency, settlement and clearing, commitments and guarantee services, etc. to corporate clients, government agencies and financial institutions. The Personal Banking Business segment offers personal loans, personal credit cards, personal insurance, personal deposits, personal financial services, remittance services, and bank card services to individual customers.
